title: Partner listing failure modes & remediation cheatsheet
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact working cheatsheet for GO-TO-MARKET and Partner Ops to diagnose common failure modes that block cloud-catalog (marketplace) listings, plus pragmatic remediation steps and ownership. Use this during handoffs and dry-runs; update with outcomes from real incidents.

Scope & audience:
- Focused on partner listing preflight and early-day launch incidents (tile publishing, billing integration, SSO/KMS, copy/UX, localization, and telemetry).
- Primary readers: partner program managers, listing owners, partner engineers, platform integrators, and support leads.

How to use:
- Walk through the checklist with the partner one week before publish and again 48 hours before go-live.
- For any red flag, follow the quick remediation path first; escalate to the named owner if unresolved in the target SLA.

Failure mode matrix (symptoms -> likely root cause -> immediate remediation -> owner):

1) Tile fails to publish (HTTP 400/500 response)
- Symptom: "Publish failed" in console, API returns 500, tile stuck in staging.
- Likely root causes: malformed metadata (missing required fields), oversized images, invalid SKU mapping, backend validation rule mismatch.
- Immediate remediation: validate JSON schema with local validator (tools/marketplace-schema/validate), reduce image size < 2MB, confirm SKU id matches billing catalog, re-run publish job with verbose logging.
- Owner: partner-engineering / marketplace-ops.

2) Listing tile shows blank or broken preview on cloud store
- Symptom: tile image missing, truncated description, placeholders visible.
- Root cause: CDN propagation delay, image asset URL not public, HTML in description not sanitized, markdown rendering edge cases.
- Remediation: flush CDN cache (ops-runbook/CDN-flush), switch to hosted assets (s3-public) if partner used private host, strip unsupported HTML tags, re-check localized variants.
- Owner: partner-ops + content-owner.

3) Trial SKU provisioning fails or trial not visible
- Symptom: customers report no "Start Trial" button or trial throws billing error during activation.
- Root cause: SKU not enabled in billing catalog, improper entitlement mapping, missing quota config, mismatched product IDs between vendor portal and billing system.
- Remediation: confirm SKU active in billing console, map entitlement in partner-portal (partner-portal/#sku-mapping), run fake order test, update quota and retry provisioning.
- Owner: billing-integration / partner success.

4) Integration test failures: SSO/OIDC or IAM permission errors
- Symptom: 401/403 in E2E tests; users cannot link accounts; role assumption fails.
- Root cause: wrong redirect URI, missing client secret in secrets manager, incorrect IAM policy (deny by default), expired certs.
- Remediation: rotate client secret in KMS, validate redirect URIs against partner config, run auth flow with debug logs, check IAM policies for least privileged allow.
- Owner: security & partner infra.

5) Duplicate or incorrect billing metering (overbilling risk)
- Symptom: usage reported twice, unexpected high token consumption for identical calls.
- Root cause: measurement point misconfiguration (counting both proxy and direct), batching/unbatching mismatch, duplicated webhook deliveries.
- Remediation: compare raw telemetry from runtime vs billing ingestion, disable duplicate webhook, apply dedupe logic in billing ingestion, schedule rollback of the last release if customer-facing charges occurred.
- Owner: finance-ops + runtime-infra.

6) Localization missing or mismatched copy
- Symptom: non-English regions show English-only tile or truncated translations.
- Root cause: locale tag mismatch, missing localized copy file, translation pipeline not triggered.
- Remediation: verify locale tags (en-US, de-DE, ja-JP), push missing translate-keys to i18n pipeline, update tile metadata to list supported locales.
- Owner: content localization + partner manager.

7) Accessibility and compliance gating at review
- Symptom: compliance team flags accessibility issues or PII handling concerns.
- Root cause: sample data in screenshots, missing alt-text, unapproved data handling descriptions.
- Remediation: remove sample PII, add alt-text to tile images, add data handling section to listing copy (data-retention, KMS, GDPR controls).
- Owner: security & compliance + product-ops.

8) Telemetry missing for post-launch metrics (no impressions, no conversions)
- Symptom: dashboards show zero impressions after listing is live.
- Root cause: tracking script not included, telemetry pipeline filter dropped events, analytics property not linked.
- Remediation: validate tracking pixel inclusion, run test event from tile, fix pipeline filter rules, ensure telemetry keys are in secrets manager.
- Owner: observability + analytics.

Quick remediation playbook (first 90 minutes):
- T+0: Triage via #partner-onboarding Slack channel. Post the tile ID, partner name, a short error screenshot/log, and the desired SLA.
- T+5: Assign primary owner from the matrix above and start an ad-hoc Zoom if customer impacted.
- T+15: Run reproducible minimal test case (publish dry-run or fake order). Capture request/response logs and correlation IDs.
- T+30: Apply short mitigation (rollback publish, disable trial SKU, swap to fallback image) to stop user impact.
- T+60: Implement permanent fix (metadata patch, schema update, pipeline rule change). Schedule postmortem if user-facing.

Preflight checklist (recommended before any publish):
- Copy & UX
  - Title <= 60 chars, subtitle <= 120 chars.
  - Short description (1 sentence) and long description (3–5 bullets) prepared per template.
  - All images: 3 sizes provided (tile, banner, hero); max dimensions and <2MB.
  - Alt-text for all images present.

- Technical & infra
  - SKU IDs validated and test orders executed.
  - SSO/OIDC client configured in partner account and secrets present in KMS.
  - IAM roles and service accounts listed with least-priv permissions.
  - CDN and asset URLs public or moved to internal host as needed.

- Billing & legal
  - Trial periods defined and represented in SKUs.
  - Pricing table reviewed (currency rounding, hourly vs monthly).
  - Legal copy approved, T&Cs link included.

- Observability & QA
  - Telemetry keys present and test events pass.
  - E2E smoke tests pass for publish, trial activation, and billing flow.
  - Alerting rule created for sudden spike in failed activations.

- Localization & compliance
  - Localized copy for target launch locales included.
  - Accessibility checklist passed (alt-text, color contrast).
  - Data handling section reviewed by compliance.

Rollout & rollback knobs (recommended):
- Canary publish: 5% visibility for first 24 hours, measure conversions and failures.
- Feature flags for trial SKU exposure (on/off per region).
- Auto-fallback tile: if any critical telemetry (publish error rate > 5%) flip to pre-approved fallback tile.

Documentation snippets for partner-facing copy (templates):
- Short description (example): "High-throughput LLM inference for production apps — predictable latency and flexible deployment options."
- How it works (bullet): "Hosted API, dedicated GPU pools, and private deployments with transparent cost controls and SLOs."
- Data handling blurb: "No customer content is shared externally; keys are managed via KMS and logs are retained per customer policy."

Escalation contacts (fast path):
- Marketplace publish failure: @TomNguyen (marketplace-ops), #partner-onboarding
- Billing/trial: @OmarPatel (billing-integration), Finance On-Call
- Security/SSO: @LenaRossi (security), Security Pager

Postmortem template items to capture after a live failure:
- Timeline and detection vector, impact (customers affected, billing exposure), root cause, remediation steps, what went well/poorly in the runbook, follow-up work + owners, and lessons learned.

Open questions (to resolve before next launch):
- Decide standard tile image hosting (partner-hosted vs. redwood-hosted) and document SLA for CDN invalidation.
- Define auto-dedupe policy for billing webhooks (idempotency keys required?).
- Create a minimal publish dry-run endpoint for partners to validate metadata without creating a live tile.

Appendix: quick commands and test endpoints
- Local schema validator: tools/marketplace-schema/validate --file tile.json
- Dry-run publish endpoint: POST /partner/v1/tile:dryrun (auth: partner-key)
- Test order flow: POST /billing/test-order {sku: <trial-sku>, user: test+partner@example.com}

Notes: keep this cheatsheet short and add concrete incident links below after each launch. Update owners if team changes.
